item.description:

Jamie Lee Voelker pleads guilty to two offenses following July 23, 2025, shooting death and subsequent break-in of neighbor’s residence

item.title: New Medicaid fraud offense will now send offenders to prison after Attorney General Ellison’s intervention
item.description:
Publication Date: August 03, 2026

AG Ellison’s bill to fight Medicaid fraud with new tools and resources, passed in May, created new penalties for committing Medicaid fraud: before, state law treated all theft above $35,000 equally, but AG Ellison’s bill created new offenses for theft over $100,000 and theft over $1,000,000

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/03_Medicaid-Fraud.asp
